hook_text: 604 020 take away 285 467. Two zeros in the way. Can you still borrow?
clip_script: Bloemfontein's reservoir: 604 020 kilolitres, and 285 467 get used. Units: 0 take away 7? Borrow! Tens: 1 take away 6? Next door is a zero, so go further left. The 4 becomes 3, the zero becomes 9. Keep going column by column: 3, 5, 5, 8, 1, 3. Answer: 318 553. Check it: add 318 553 and 285 467. Back to 604 020! Adding? Start on the right and carry the tens: 486 357 plus 275 896 is 762 253. Carry it, borrow it, check it.
visual_style: Column sums with carried digits floating up to the next column and zeros flipping into nines when borrowed across.
mood: Steady and satisfying, like solving a puzzle.
pacing: One column at a time with a click on each carry or borrow, then a quick check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and add up the books from three schools.
